info.title: Civilisation Atlas API
info.description: Design contract, not a deployed service. Historical year API uses positive display year + BCE/CE; internal temporal extents use astronomical integers. Privacy, draft lifecycle and database policies are implementation gates.

delete.description: Requires recent reauthentication. Provider and app erasure are coordinated and retryable.
Ownership from verified session. Repeated deletion is idempotent; no cross-owner existence disclosure.

get.description: Admin role only. Does not return private bookmarks. Requires server-side role enforcement and verified MFA. See security matrix; authentication alone is insufficient.

patch.summary: Grant or revoke an application role
patch.description: Admin only, recent reauthentication. Cannot remove the last active admin. Role not read from profile metadata. Requires server-side role enforcement and verified MFA. See security matrix; authentication alone is insufficient.

Admin only; immediate permission revocation and audit. Last active admin safety applies. Requires server-side role enforcement and verified MFA. See security matrix; authentication alone is insufficient.

post.description: Editor capability required. UUIDs are client-generated; uniqueness, reference permissions and full type-specific schemas checked. This draft v0.1 contract will be refined before implementation. Requires server-side role enforcement and verified MFA. See security matrix; authentication alone is insufficient. Editing creates a successor revision via parentRevisionId and If-Match; published revisions are never mutated.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required with parentRevisionId; previous draft content hash. Stale hash returns 412.
